note: Sunday blessing, Psalm 29:11, 2 slides, no redraws
caption:
A blessing for your week. Send it to someone you are praying for.

Strength for the hard days and peace for the quiet ones, both from the same faithful hands. May this week hold a little of each for you.

Psalm 29:11 (BSB)

Keep this one close.
